hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) pnpm exec prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" 2>/dev/null; pnpm exec eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null;; *.js|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json|*.css|*.md) pnpm exec prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" 2>/dev/null;; esac; } || true

branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); status=$(git status --short 2>/dev/null | head -20); [ -z "$status" ] && status="(clean)"; files=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | head -10); context=$(printf '### Session State
- Branch: %s

#### Changed Files
%s

#### Uncommitted Changes
%s' "$branch" "$files" "$status"); jq -n --arg ctx "$context" '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreCompact", "additionalContext": $ctx}}'
